description: This file contains implementation of battery simulation functions related to voltage equalization, thermal modeling, and degradation processes within the 'slide::paperCode::paper2022' namespace. It defines functions for simulating voltage equalization, thermal effects, and various degradation scenarios for battery modules and cells.

classes.name: slide::DEG_ID
classes.description: Structure representing degradation identification parameters, including models for SEI, porosity, and LAM.

classes.name: slide::StorageUnit
classes.description: Base class for storage units like cells and modules.

classes.name: slide::Cell_SPM
classes.description: Class representing a specific type of battery cell with parameters for simulation.

classes.name: slide::Module_p
classes.description: Class representing a module of cells with specific configuration.

classes.name: slide::Cycler
classes.description: Class for performing charge/discharge cycling simulations.

classes.name: slide::ThroughputData
classes.description: Data structure for storing throughput data during simulations.

classes.name: slide::Procedure
classes.description: Class for managing battery cycle aging procedures.

classes.name: slide::Battery
classes.description: Class representing a battery composed of modules and cells.

methods.name: Vequalisation_Rdc
methods.description: Simulates voltage equalization in a battery module with specified contact resistance.

methods.name: Vequalisation
methods.description: Runs voltage equalization simulations with different contact resistances.

methods.name: thermalModel
methods.description: Simulates thermal effects in a small battery module.

methods.name: degradation_1cell
methods.description: Simulates degradation for a single cell multiplied to form a large battery.

methods.name: degradation_electricalModel
methods.description: Simulates degradation considering contact resistances in a battery with identical cells.

methods.name: degradation_variations
methods.description: Simulates effects of cell-to-cell variations on degradation.
